communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: FOIA US Navy record 9/1 Blackburn
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Military service records for subject below;
Name: Leroy Blackburn
Branch: United States Navy
DOB: 04/17/1928
Dates of Service: Approx yrs 1948 to 1969
Passed: 03/22/2012

Request following documents;
1) copy of Bronze Star Medal award citations
2) copy of Navy Commendation Medal award citations
3) History of assignments form NAVPERS 601-5
4) Presidential Unit Citation award certificate
5) Training courses NAVPERS form 601-4
6) List of Awards, date of discharge
7) Navy achievement medal award citation 
Vietnam War
Redact per 5 U.S.C. § 552(b)(6).
I request hard copies of paperwork in the file showing this information.
Please mail hardcopies to:
MUCKROCK NEWS Dept MR#
263 HUNTINGTON AVE
BOSTON, MA 02115

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Eric Bradley

title: Stamford Police Department Policy and Procedure Manual in Effect in 2019
Talent Police Department Flock and ALPR camera policy, invoice, map, and contracts

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oregon Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

I am requesting current versions of the following records, which have already been requested to Talent Police Department. By requesting current versions of previously produced records, I am hopeful that this request will require minimal labor to locate, review and produce the records. Please let me know if you need any additional information or clarification regarding the records I am seeking.

The records I am seeking are:

(1) all policies Talent Police Department has that oversee and/or regulate the operation and use of Automated License Plate Readers, including the operation and use of Flock, Vigilant, Axon, or any similar ALPR programs and softwares
(2) a copy of any and all invoices Talent Police Department has between any and all Automated License Plate Readers softwares and programs, including Flock, Vigilant, Axon, or any similar ALPR programs and softwares
(3) a map of all ALPR cameras that Talent Police Department owns, operates or has access to
(4) a copy of any and all license and user agreements, contracts, memorandums of understanding or other similar type documents that describe and/or regulate the use, retention, collection, and sharing of ALPR data including but not limited to the agreements between Flock, Vigilant, Axon, or any similar ALPR programs and softwares

Please segregate all non-exempt material, and “black out” rather than “white out” any exempt material. Please cite specific exemptions in every instance that  the public body claims an exemption.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Southern Oregon Flock Off
